en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a landscaped park scene with a small decorative wooden pavilion or hut surrounded by trees and shrubs. Several well‑dressed people from the late 19th or early 20th century—women in long dresses and hats, men in suits or uniforms, and a young girl—stroll along a curved path. A printed caption panel in German appears in the lower right corner, and the publisher's imprint is printed in red at the bottom.
